scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 16 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-the-alexandriysky-park-oranienbau.story: 65 km from Peterhof to Peterhof, about 1 h 07 of riding. It goes by way of The Maximov's Datcha, Oranienbaumsky Springboard and back through The Maximov's Datcha. The line favours views over speed.
